claim_boundary: the historical sample has been visible to prior CZSC research and is not independent OOS
the exact portfolio-level time-series rule has not previously been evaluated in this workspace
2024plus is a gated temporal validation but remains retrospective
a pass creates a prospective forward-test candidate only
a failure closes this exact 20-decision zero-threshold overlay without lookback, threshold, hysteresis, or leverage rescue

mechanism.hypothesis: stock-level entry and exit filters are weak, but reducing the entire unchanged factor F book when its own realized 20-decision trend is negative can improve drawdown and risk-adjusted return
mechanism.distinct_from_failed_market_state_filter: uses only the causal realized NAV of the investable F portfolio, not cross-sectional breadth, median momentum, or FSM state composition

overlay.signal_at_decision_close: F_BASELINE close NAV divided by its close NAV 20 decision dates earlier minus one
overlay.risk_off: less than or equal to zero
overlay.warmup: cash through the first 20 decision dates
overlay.risk_on_target: the exact contemporaneous frozen F membership

execution.prices: qfq open fills and qfq close daily marks
execution.missing_buy_open: skip and keep cash until a later weekly decision
execution.missing_sell_open: remain pending until the next observable stock open

decision_rules.development_pass: risk-on decision rate in [25%,85%]; candidate annualized return>0; max-drawdown magnitude reduced>=15%; Sharpe improves>=0.15; annualized return no more than 1pp below F; weekly paired-return noninferiority one-sided HAC p<0.05
decision_rules.validation_opening: validation paths, signals, and statistics are not computed or persisted unless every development gate passes
decision_rules.validation_pass: same primary rules; both locked validation subperiod candidate total returns>0 and paired total returns>=-2pp
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp candidate annualized return>0 and max drawdown is lower than F in both development and validation
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_TSMOM_CANDIDATE_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if development, validation, and cost stress all pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_RETROSPECTIVE; no alternate lookback, threshold, hysteresis, or leverage rescue
